The '''Office of Extraplanetary Relations''' was a civil diplomatic body on [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]] that dealt with the diplomatic needs of the Manaan government.

==History==
{{Quote|I think it strange for the Office of Ethics to be so capitulating to the so-called 'alarmists in the popular press.' Surely, the 'ethical' thing to do is foment peace with whomever we can. We see this report as a positive step toward normalizing relations with the Empire, once this has all blown over.|The [[Director of the Office of Extraplanetary Relations]]|<ref name="TOR:MtN" />}}
In an effort to preserve [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] culture, they created the [[Department of Selkath Ethnology]] and established the [[Manaan Visitor's Center]] in [[Ahto City/Legends|Ahto City]].<ref name="Codex" /> During the time of the [[Invasion of Manaan]], the Office came into possession of a report about untapped [[Kolto/Legends|kolto]] reserves discovered by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Despite fears it would lead to a civil war, and attempts to suppress the report, it ultimately surfaced and was leaked, with the [[Director of the Office of Extraplanetary Relations|Director]] stating that they didn't mind that it had leaked, as they hoped it would bring the Selkath closer ties to the Sith.<ref name="TOR:MtN"/>
